declared_guest_exit.reason: Detcore refuses guest ptrace with a deterministic EPERM (the privileged-observation boundary), so PTRACE_TRACEME fails in the child and this host PMU diagnostic exits with its dedicated refused-ptrace status 3 (EXIT_PTRACE_REFUSED), distinct from the EXIT_FAILURE that every other failure path returns.
